decisions.reason: Core transactional email service with home page prominence, strong strategic fit, and low cost to keep; option value remains high.
Document capture has demonstrated customer value and specific use cases, reducing uncertainty and justifying continued investment.
Email-fax conversion still serves compliance and bridge needs in regulated German industries, with low marginal cost to keep the option open.
Fax optimization is close to the established offer but remains low-cost to maintain as an enhancement, and its option value is not yet clearly negative.
Email sandbox threat protection addresses growing security needs, and keeping it open is inexpensive while uncertainty about its full value persists.
